deductions.title: How did the intruder really get in?
deductions.prompt: The house is set up to look like someone smashed the window and climbed in. Choose what really happened, tick the evidence that proves it, then connect it.

answers.text: They smashed the window and climbed in.
answers.rebuttal: Then the glass would be all over the carpet. Most of it is out on the porch.

answers.text: They came in through the back door.
answers.rebuttal: The back door is bolted and chained from the inside. Nobody used it.

answers.text: They forced the front door lock.
answers.rebuttal: There isn't a single scratch on that lock.

answers.text: They used our spare key, then faked a break-in.

deductions.hint_missing: That's what happened, but I can't prove it yet. What shows the window was faked? What shows how they opened the door?
deductions.hint_irrelevant: One of these clues doesn't say anything about how they got in. Leave it out.
deductions.hint_not_found: I think I know what happened, but I haven't found enough proof yet. The window, the front door and the key hooks might tell me more.
